title: Pricing
description: Explore PaperEnjoyer’s upcoming Free, Lite and Pro plans, credit packs and monthly subscription rules.
intro:
Read, understand and build on your papers.
Choose the space and AI allowance that fit your research.
statusText: The allowances, offers and features below describe our planned subscription release. They are not the entitlements of the current free app. Paid plans and credit packs are coming soon.

Free.rollover: Monthly credits expire each cycle; no rollover.

Lite.rollover: Carry credits for up to {rolloverMonths} months, capped at {rolloverCap}.

Pro.rollover: Carry credits for up to {rolloverMonths} months, capped at {rolloverCap}.

taxes: Prices are in USD. Applicable taxes and the final total will be shown before payment when checkout opens.
packsText: One-time packs for any plan. Purchased credits do not expire or reset each month.

welcome.title: A welcome to new readers
welcome.first: The planned sign-up offer is {welcomeCredits} bonus Credits, valid for {welcomeDays} days from registration. They cannot be transferred or redeemed for cash. Unlike purchased credit packs, this gift expires.
welcome.second: Eligible new accounts can purchase their first month of Lite for {firstMonthPrice} within {introDays} days of registration, once per account. It then renews at {litePrice} per month unless cancelled.

spending.title: Monthly credits, then purchased credits
spending.first: Subscription credits are used first. Purchased credits cover usage after that allowance is exhausted. Lite and Pro rollover is limited by both the age and the balance cap shown above; excess does not accumulate.
spending.second: Credits measure use of PaperEnjoyer features. They are not money, an investment or a transferable balance. Separate providers may charge for services you connect yourself.

renewal.title: Renewal and cancellation
renewal.first: Paid subscriptions renew monthly on the billing schedule shown at purchase. The monthly allowance refreshes at the start of each subscription period, not necessarily on the first day of the calendar month.
renewal.second: Cancel before renewal to stop the next charge. Your current paid benefits last until the period ends; new paid-plan allocations then stop. Purchased credits remain. Refund requests are addressed in the policy linked below.

downgrade.title: Your library after a downgrade
downgrade.first: If stored data exceeds your new plan’s limit, existing data is retained. New uploads are restricted until you free enough space or upgrade.
downgrade.second: Changing a subscription does not make your purchased credits expire. Account deletion and refunded purchases are handled separately under the terms and privacy policy linked below.

usageText: Planning estimates, not fixed quotes or a guaranteed number of papers. Usage varies with page count, tokens, images, model choice and task complexity.
startText: The current free app is available now. Its available models and usage limits are shown in the app; the upcoming allowances above have not launched.
